svg.title: Finding 5: Multi-agent debate degrades accuracy; adversarial personas stay within a point
svg.desc: The best multi-agent debate (Qwen3-4B, 87.67%) falls 0.77 points below Qwen3-4B alone. The best majority-voting jury of three is 0.11 points above the best single judge. Under six adversarial personas, Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B move 0.56 and 0.10 points.
svg.text: the best debate against Qwen3-4B alone

g.text: tick: the same judge without the strategy

svg.text: adversarial personas stay within a point
